slug: 2026-02-27 Zambia partners with PAYZ to boost financial inclusion

ZMB.note: Bank of Zambia only attended the meeting; no role stated.
Regulatory harmonisation mentioned without any consumer rule.
Digital payments within agencies mentioned as an aim only, no programme.

facts.fact: President Hichilema describes the Payments Association of Zambia as representing a mobile money sector that has extended financial services to unbanked rural communities through agency networks.
